title: Write review 2 of the revised study design, passing policy test
summary: Re-check the revised study-capability M1 design (docs/design/study-capability-m1.md) against review 1's findings and write it up as review 2. The prior attempt failed only because review 2 used a word the repository's boundary test bans ("operators"); reword so cargo test passes.

defaults_applied.how: Review findings cite design sections and review-1 items.
Review written for an outside reader.
cargo test must pass, including the boundary policy test.
One review document, minimal edits elsewhere.

assumptions: Review 2 does not exist in the current tree; the earlier attempt's file was discarded, so it must be written again.
'Re-check' means a written design review per the design's section 9 gate, not code changes.
The banned-word list in policy.rs is not to be edited.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/reviews/study-capability-m1-review-2.md exists, checks each review-1 finding and decision against the revised design, and gives a verdict (approve, or approve with named changes), citing sections.
The review contains none of the words banned by the boundary scan in xtask/tests/policy.rs (e.g. 'operators'); it never refers to who runs Athena or where.
If the design's status or review-gate section is updated to record review 2, links resolve and no governance file is changed.
Run `cargo test --locked`: all tests pass, including athena_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_it_or_where.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --locked`: both clean.

out_of_scope: Editing policy.rs or any governance file
